dialogues.jp: 「ふぃぃ……」

ちょっとばかし苦労して椅子に腰掛けると机に
突っ伏す。机に立てかけた松葉杖が邪魔くさい。
dialogues.en:
I worked hard to sit on my chair and laid my head against
the desk. Having my crutches beside my desk was annoying.
dialogues.text:
I worked hard to sit on my chair and laid my head against
the desk. Having my crutches beside my desk was annoying.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おっ、ようやくまともに来たな」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you're on time today."
dialogues.text: "Hey, you're on time today."

dialogues.jp:
本校でも同じクラスになった杉並が、接近して
くる。
dialogues.en:
Suginami, who was in the same class as me again, came toward
me.
dialogues.text:
Suginami, who was in the same class as me again, came toward
me.

dialogues.jp: 「まぁな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
クラスを見回すと、さすがにクラス替えがあっ
ただけあって、知らん顔がちらほらいる。
dialogues.en:
When I looked around the classroom, I noticed unfamiliar
faces around me.
dialogues.text:
When I looked around the classroom, I noticed unfamiliar
faces around me.

dialogues.jp:
一昨日は、クラスの人間を見回している余裕な
んかなかったからな……。
dialogues.en:
I didn't have time to check out my new classmates on the
first day......
dialogues.text:
I didn't have time to check out my new classmates on the
first day......

dialogues.jp:
と、クラスの男どもがちらちら盗み見ている先
に、ことりの姿があった。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, I realized that all the guys in the class were
staring at Kotori.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, I realized that all the guys in the class were
staring at Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
さらに教室を見回すが、他に特徴的なものはな
い。俺のまわりでは音夢がいなくなって、眞子
が違うクラスになったことぐらいだ。
dialogues.en:
I looked around again, but there was nothing special about
the class. The only thing that's significantly different for
me was that Nemu was gone, and Mako's now in a different
class.
dialogues.text:
I looked around again, but there was nothing special about
the class. The only thing that's significantly different for
me was that Nemu was gone, and Mako's now in a different
class.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうした？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「別に。まぁ……強いて言えば、緊張気味の外
　部生の姿が、微笑ましいってところかな」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing. It's kind of funny to see how new kids from other
schools are looking so nervous......"
dialogues.text:
"Nothing. It's kind of funny to see how new kids from other
schools are looking so nervous......"

dialogues.jp:
付属から本校に上がっただけの｛おれら／内部生｝とは違っ
て、他の学園から来た奴らにとっては正真正銘、
初めての学園だからな。
dialogues.en:
I came to this school from the affiliated school, but for
some kids, this school's brand new to them.
dialogues.text:
I came to this school from the affiliated school, but for
some kids, this school's brand new to them.

dialogues.jp:
｛さすが／流石｝に授業が始まってから３日目だけあって、
会話は交わされてるけど。まだまだ、はじけて
ない。
dialogues.en:
It's the 3rd day of school, so they still seem to be
uncomfortable here.
dialogues.text:
It's the 3rd day of school, so they still seem to be
uncomfortable here.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「人類の環境への適応能力は高い。彼らもじき
　に慣れるさ」
dialogues.en:
"Mankind can adapt to an environment quickly. They'll get
used to this soon."
dialogues.text:
"Mankind can adapt to an environment quickly. They'll get
used to this soon."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「随分と飛躍した｛たと／喩｝えだな」
dialogues.en: "That's a unique way to put it."
dialogues.text: "That's a unique way to put it."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それはそうと、また事故にでもあったのか？」
dialogues.en: "By the way, did you get into an accident again?"
dialogues.text: "By the way, did you get into an accident again?"

dialogues.jp: 杉並が俺の頭に巻かれている包帯を指す。
dialogues.en: Suginami pointed at the bandage around my head.
dialogues.text: Suginami pointed at the bandage around my head.

dialogues.jp:
「ああ……ちょっと今朝、文字通り叩き起こさ
　れてな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah...... I was literally woke up roughly."
dialogues.text: "Yeah...... I was literally woke up roughly."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだそりゃ……」
dialogues.en: "What's that......?"
dialogues.text: "What's that......?"

dialogues.jp: ｛けげん／怪訝｝そうな杉並を無視して机にへばりつく。
dialogues.en:
I ignored him and hugged my desk as he looked at me with
confusion.
dialogues.text:
I ignored him and hugged my desk as he looked at me with
confusion.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、いた」
dialogues.en: "Oh, there you are."
dialogues.text: "Oh, there you are."

dialogues.jp:
身体を後ろにひねると、近づいてくる眞子の姿
が目に入る。
dialogues.en: When I turned around, I saw Mako walking toward me.
dialogues.text: When I turned around, I saw Mako walking toward me.

dialogues.jp: 「黒幕の登場か……」
dialogues.en: "The godfather's here......"
dialogues.text: "The godfather's here......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いや……なんの用だ？」
dialogues.en: "It's nothing...... What did you want?"
dialogues.text: "It's nothing...... What did you want?"

dialogues.jp: 死亡確認――ってところか？
dialogues.en: Did she come to make sure I'm alive......?
dialogues.text: Did she come to make sure I'm alive......?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「なんの用って、お姉ちゃんの様子を聞きに来
　たに決まってるじゃない」
dialogues.en: "Of course, I came here to ask you how my sister's doing!"
dialogues.text: "Of course, I came here to ask you how my sister's doing!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Oh."
dialogues.text: "Oh."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうして朝倉に聞くんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you asking Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you asking Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……かったるいんだろ」
dialogues.en: "......She's probably just tired."
dialogues.text: "......She's probably just tired."

dialogues.jp: 口が裂けても同棲していることは言えん。
dialogues.en: I can't tell him that I'm living with her.
dialogues.text: I can't tell him that I'm living with her.

dialogues.jp: 「様子については問題ない。いつも通りだ」
dialogues.en: "She's doing just fine. Everything's normal."
dialogues.text: "She's doing just fine. Everything's normal."

dialogues.jp: 同棲状況については、いまさら言うまい。
dialogues.en: I don't need to tell her in detail.
dialogues.text: I don't need to tell her in detail.

dialogues.jp:
「それはそれとして、萌先輩にヘンなことを教
　えるな」
dialogues.en: "By the way, don't tell Moe-sempai strange things."
dialogues.text: "By the way, don't tell Moe-sempai strange things."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「変なことって？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by strange things?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by strange things?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩を使って、俺を殺そうとしただろう」
dialogues.en:
"You tried to kill me by using Moe-sempai as your agent,
didn't you?"
dialogues.text:
"You tried to kill me by using Moe-sempai as your agent,
didn't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、あれね」
dialogues.en: "Oh, that?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, that?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「嬉しかったでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "Did you like it?"
dialogues.text: "Did you like it?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「んなわけあるかッ！　この白いもんが、お前
　には見えんのか？」
dialogues.en: "No way! Can't you see this white thing around my head?"
dialogues.text: "No way! Can't you see this white thing around my head?"

dialogues.jp: 頭に巻きついている包帯を指す。
dialogues.en: I pointed at the bandage around my head.
dialogues.text: I pointed at the bandage around my head.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「オーバーね」
dialogues.en: "Don't be dramatic."
dialogues.text: "Don't be dramatic."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「調理直後のフライパンでな……」
dialogues.en: "It was a hot frying pan......"
dialogues.text: "It was a hot frying pan......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あはは……」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「笑ってごまかすな！　魔法剣並みの威力だっ
　たんだぞ！」
dialogues.en: "Don't try and laugh it away! I thought I was going to die!"
dialogues.text: "Don't try and laugh it away! I thought I was going to die!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、無事だったんだし、よかったじゃない」
dialogues.en: "Well, you're safe now. Everything's fine, right?"
dialogues.text: "Well, you're safe now. Everything's fine, right?"

dialogues.jp: これを｛ぶじ／無傷｝というのか？
dialogues.en: She's saying that everything's fine?
dialogues.text: She's saying that everything's fine?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あたし、もう戻るね」
dialogues.en: "I need to go now."
dialogues.text: "I need to go now."

dialogues.jp: スタスタと歩いて、離脱していく。
dialogues.en: She walked away from me.
dialogues.text: She walked away from me.

dialogues.jp: 「……やれやれ」
dialogues.en: "......Good grief."
dialogues.text: "......Good grief."

dialogues.jp:
追うのも面倒で身体の向きを直し、杉並を見上
げると――。
dialogues.en: Not feeling like chasing her, I turned back toward Suginami.
dialogues.text: Not feeling like chasing her, I turned back toward Suginami.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「自分の手を汚さずに相手を追い込むとは……
　やはり侮れん」
dialogues.en:
"Hurting someone without dirtying her own hands...... I have
great respect for her..."
dialogues.text:
"Hurting someone without dirtying her own hands...... I have
great respect for her..."

dialogues.jp: 自分の世界に入っていた。
dialogues.en: He was in his own world.
dialogues.text: He was in his own world.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……かったる」
dialogues.en: "Huh...... What a pain."
dialogues.text: "Huh...... What a pain."

dialogues.jp:
窓の外には、季節どおりとなった風景が広がっ
ていた。
dialogues.en: I turn to watch the spring view through the window.
dialogues.text: I turn to watch the spring view through the window.

dialogues.jp: ◆新しい教室にて◆
dialogues.en: ◆In the new classroom◆
dialogues.text: ◆In the new classroom◆

dialogues.jp: 新学期になって、初めての登校だ。
dialogues.en: It was the first day I showed up to the new classroom.
dialogues.text: It was the first day I showed up to the new classroom.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩の様子を｛き／訊｝きに来た眞子に、俺は文句を
言ってやった。萌先輩に変な事を吹き込むなよ
な……。
dialogues.en:
I complained to Mako as she came to check out how Moe-sempai
was doing. I don't want her to tell Moe-sempai any more
strange things......
dialogues.text:
I complained to Mako as she came to check out how Moe-sempai
was doing. I don't want her to tell Moe-sempai any more
strange things......
